newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy DPEF to contain social reform details - Ciampi.
newsitem.headline: Italy DPEF to contain social reform details - Ciampi.

text.p: Italian Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said the government's three-year economic target document (DPEF) will contain details relating to the planned reform of the country's social welfare system.
The document of rolling targets for the period 1998-2000 has to be drawn up by May 15.
Ciampi, asked by reporters about a timeframe for social security and pension reforms, replied "I can't predict that but certainly the DPEF should give some indications on the issue."
Prime Minister Romano Prodi's centre-left government has said it wants to start round-table discussions with employers and trades unions on the crucial social reforms very soon.

Ciampi said the government wanted to look at the overall question of social spending over the medium and long term. "The pensions system comes within this framework and the government is committed to start examining this over the coming weeks," he added.
